Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded the shared genre was “post-punk” despite the evidence showing INXS listed as new wave/pub rock/dance-rock/funk rock/alternative rock (i.e., rock) and not post-punk. The correct overlap is rock; the Planner ignored the broader, supported genre and cited an unsupported subgenre.
